verdict.rationale: Computer can see and operate web applications, but only inside its own cloud environment: it runs browser tasks, takes webpage screenshots, browses login-gated pages, and works in a sandboxed Linux VM. Apps like Gmail, Slack and GitHub are driven through API connectors rather than visual control. Nothing shows it seeing or controlling applications on the user's own machine; the 'Portable Computer' mentions describe running the harness locally on a DGX Spark, not desktop app control. Missing for 10: local desktop/screen control of the user's own computer, operation of native (non-web) applications, hands-on corroboration of computer-use behavior.
